title: Tenant
tenantIdHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 2-20 characters, starting with a letter or digit. Cannot be changed after creation
tenantIdInvalid: Use 2-20 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit
packageHelp: Menus the tenant can use. After changing the package, the tenant admin's menus are updated
packageUnavailable: (Package disabled or deleted. Select another one)
domainHelp: Optional. When the login page is opened on this domain, this tenant is selected and locked
expired: Expired: users of this tenant cannot log in
adminUserNameLength: The admin username must be 2-30 characters
adminPasswordLength: The admin password must be 8-64 characters
adminHelp: Also creates the tenant's root department, an admin role (with every menu in the package) and the admin account
defaultTenantTip: The default tenant (platform) cannot be disabled or deleted
confirmDelete: Delete tenant "{name}"? Its users will no longer be able to log in
confirmBatchDelete: Delete the {count} selected tenants? Their users will no longer be able to log in

switcher.label: Switch tenant
switcher.insideTip: You are viewing and maintaining this tenant's data as the super admin. Exit to return to the platform
